mapper.insert: INSERT INTO photo.photo_mst ( account_no, photo_no, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, is_deleted, photo_at, location_no, image_file_path, photo_japanese_title, photo_english_title, caption, direction_kbn, focal_length, f_value, shutter_speed, iso ) VALUES ( #{accountNo, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.AccountNoTypeHandler}, #{photoNo, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.PhotoNoTypeHandler}, #{createdBy, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.CreatedByTypeHandler}, NOW(), #{updatedBy, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.UpdatedByTypeHandler}, NOW(), false, #{photoAt, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.PhotoAtTypeHandler}, #{locationNo, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.LocationNoTypeHandler}, #{imageFilePath, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.ImageFilePathTypeHandler}, #{photoJapaneseTitle, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.PhotoJapaneseTitleTypeHandler}, #{photoEnglishTitle, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.PhotoEnglishTitleTypeHandler}, #{caption, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.CaptionTypeHandler}, #{directionKbn}::photo.direction_enum, #{focalLength, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.FocalLengthTypeHandler}, #{fValue, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.FValueTypeHandler}, #{shutterSpeed, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.ShutterSpeedTypeHandler}, #{iso, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.IsoTypeHandler} )
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(photo_no) AS photoNo FROM photo.photo_mst WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN true ELSE false END FROM photo.photo_mst WHERE account_no = #{accountNo, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.AccountNoTypeHandler} AND image_file_path LIKE CONCAT('%', #{imageFilePath, typeHandler=com.web.gallery.type_handler.ImageFilePathTypeHandler}) AND is_deleted = false
SELECT photo_no AS photoNo FROM photo.photo_mst WHERE account_no = #{accountNo}
